title: Automotive Glass & Forward-Facing ADAS Coverage
citation: UAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy (CBUAE Endorsement — Glass Cover applied by Sukoon and UAE Insurers)
text: The policy covers accidental breakage, shattering, or cracking of the front windshield, rear glass, or side windows. Certified replacement of automotive safety glass and necessary recalibration of forward-facing ADAS camera/radar sensors bonded to the glass shall be indemnified without applying the collision deductible, up to the stated glass cover sub-limit.
